description: Register a webhook: every change on this library's feed (retired, disputed, revised, supplied, ?) is POSTed to your address, signed with a secret (X-ResearchZosho-Signature: sha256=hmac). The changes feed stays the source of truth. Needs a named patron.

events.description: Optional: only these events (retired, disputed, revised, supplied, accepted, ?). Absent = all.

patron.description: Optional: who is asking ? {did, name, runtime}. Anonymous when absent.

secret.description: Optional. The signing secret; one is made for you when absent and returned once.

url.description: Where to POST. http(s); a program on this machine is fine.

name: library_subscribe
